versions.changelog:
- Added English and Chinese README files for improved documentation and user guidance.
- Removed the skill-card.md file to streamline documentation.
- Documentation in SKILL.md has been updated and simplified, with reduced emphasis on the built-in public API Key and related free quota details. 
- First-use instructions now require users to configure their own API Key.
- User manual and FAQ have been revised for conciseness and clarity.

- Documentation files (README.md, README.en.md, skill-card.md) have been removed.
- SKILL.md has been streamlined, with some non-essential usage and introduction content trimmed for conciseness.
- No changes to features or functionality; this is a documentation and cleanup update only.

- 内置公共 API Key，首次使用开箱即用，无需配置，支持约 10000 次免费额度
- 文档显著优化，强调免注册和免费试用体验
- 增加“首次使用”与“后续使用”分步说明，清晰指引如何获取和配置个人 API Key
- 简化“依赖安装”和环境变量说明，降低上手门槛
- 移除 skill-card.md 文件，保持项目结构精简

- 移除了 skill-card.md 文件。
- SKILL.md 文档内容有细微更新，主标题改为“seedance2.0开源版”，但功能与用法未发生实际变化。
- 其余功能、参数和使用方式保持不变。

Seedance 视频生成器首次发布，基于 Seedance 2.0 模型，支持文本生成短视频。

- 支持中文/英文提示词一行命令生成带音频 MP4 视频
- 参数可控：分辨率、比例、时长、虚拟人像选择、随机种子等
- 提供尾帧提取、自动任务轮询与管理、进度与结果查询
- 无需 SDK 配置或白名单、注册即可用、API Key 配置灵活
- 针对创作、产品演示、品牌运营、设计教育等场景优化
- 附详尽命令、安装和常见问题指南
